title: 别再忘记刚学到的东西：自我导向修复让智能体的错误变成持久经验
summary: 该论文提出Self-Direction机制：智能体任务失败后反思轨迹并提取教训，将其蒸馏为仅占基座模型约0.02%参数的低秩适配器，存入持久化经验库并按需路由复用。在GAIA、Claw-Eval、Terminal-Bench 2.1上成功率提升8.9至17.0个百分点，显著减少重复错误，少量适配器可泛化到数十个新任务。
summary_en: The paper introduces Self-Direction, a mechanism where an agent reflects on failed trajectories, distills each lesson into a lightweight low-rank adapter (~0.02% of base parameters) with frozen base weights, and stores adapters in a persistent lesson library routed to solve related tasks. On GAIA, Claw-Eval, and Terminal-Bench 2.1, it improves success rates by 8.9-17.0 points, nearly doubles correction reliability, and a few adapters generalize to dozens of new tasks.
